review_description: Nothing but lies and crap service from the day after they got our money.NEVER again.

I have recommended your service to two other people who are considering solar panel installation.All three companies' representatives made appointments, were punctual and had great advice/knowledge of their products.The range of prices and different makes of systems was impressive and certainly helped to make up our minds on what to choose for our particular needs.Keep up the good work.

We had spoken with a few Solar Companies but from the moment we met Jason for our quote we knew we had found our Solar Installers, we did have a look at a few other installers afterwards but they did not meet our requirements, one well known company even came in and did not even explain there products clearly but had the paper work pre-filled in and just said they required a signature.Jason explained everything very clearly and timelines. We couldn't of been more happier with the service we received from Jason and the the installers. I have friends looking at Solar and have recommended Season Makers.
Jason at Season Makers Rockingham is a very friendly person.
I have no hesitation to recommend them. They took care of everything, thus we had absolutely nothing to do.
